disposition_reason: Original total arsenic and arsenic species (iAs, DMA, roxarsone) measurements in raw and baked retail chicken breast from 10 US cities.

study.design: Retail market basket sample with arsenic speciation and risk assessment
study.market: 82 grocery stores (47 supermarket chains) in 10 US metropolitan areas
study.method: Total As by ICP-MS after acid digestion of freeze-dried tissue; species by anion-exchange HPLC-ICP-MS; wet weight back-calculated
lod: LOD 1 µg/kg DW for total As, iAs, DMA, MMA; 2 µg/kg DW for roxarsone
study.qa: SRM 1568a rice flour (certified 290 ± 30 µg/kg, found 310 ± 10); in-house rice RM 252 ± 7 µg/kg (CV 2.9%); in-house low-arsenic chicken breast RM
